content.comment_body: Hello everyone, [product_name] is very slow to open certain windows, such as the Properties window, while other parts of the program run normally. See the video. Any advice? Thanks! [user_name]
Hi [user_name], You could try updating your Java version on your PC and check if the issue persists. Also, review the system requirements for the software to ensure compatibility.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report sluggishness when opening specific windows, like Properties, in [product_name] [version_no]. The rest of the software seems to perform as expected, suggesting the problem is isolated to certain features. This feedback indicates user frustration with responsiveness and hints at possible issues with compatibility or system configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all windows, especially frequently used ones like Properties, to open quickly and for the application to work efficiently without unexplained lag.
